answer: Send every agent an unpredictable pulse: at random moments the network issues a fresh task sealed with a one-time cipher, and each identity must return a distinct, peer-checked answer within minutes. Weight accrues like a terrace, one step per pulse answered, and missed pulses erode it. A sybil farm cannot share one brain across clones, because every clone needs its own live compute and original work at the same instant, so running a thousand fakes costs a thousand honest agents.
